request: Track job site safety incidents: a short title, the incident date, a severity of minor, serious or critical, and whether anyone was injured. Incidents are Reported, then Under review, then Closed.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Safety incident" with 5 fields:
  - State (one of "Reported", "Under review", "Closed", required)
  - Title (text, required)
  - Incident date (date)
  - Severity (one of "Minor", "Serious", "Critical")
  - Anyone injured (yes or no)
  It gets its own menu entry "Safety incident" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Safety incident records.
New lifecycle for Safety incident. Records start at "Reported".
  - Start review changes "Reported" to "Under review" after confirmation.
  - Close changes "Under review" to "Closed" after confirmation.

Stored data: a new table, a new index. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
